integrity: Complete self-contained proof, two standalone standard-library numerical checks, and recorded outputs are bundled; finite enumerations corroborate but do not certify infinite claims. All embedded files have actual bytes and SHA-256 digests.
scientific_limitations: Balanced subspace-disjointness graphs only, with \(q\) a prime power and \(k\ge2\). Orbit recovery in the marked graph is not graph identification among arbitrary graphs. Classical subspace association-scheme intersection parameters and automorphism facts predate this theorem; independent priority and scientific audit not performed.
title: One-anchor, two-round orbit recovery in balanced subspace Kneser graphs
